annotations.text:
Design pass: gate triage modal (board).
Direction ratified 2026-09-09: TRIAGE QUEUE. One modal session walks every pending gate on the board; pips track gates, dots track questions inside the active gate, footer peeks the next gate. Buttons take the mantine-style light variant (color at low alpha, no edge).
Next: spec every state as Storybook stories for sign-off, then implement.
Baseline PNGs of all 22 catalog stories: docs/design/gate-cards/baseline/.

Actions live at their own level now: gate-level (focus pane, skip gate) as ghost buttons on the gate strip; step-level (previous, solid next) in the footer; reset as ghost text. Queue pips moved to the header beside the count.
Open queue semantics to settle before stories:
1. Entry point: header triage button, gate chip on a row, or both (chip enters the queue positioned at that gate).
2. Skip gate: advances without answering; draft and gate stay untouched (rt has no skip verb).
3. Queue scope and order: which gates join, and in what order.

Pass input 2: dark contrast on the cards. Left column is today's exact values; right lifts row and control edges, brightens muted text, amber wash on the checked row, light-variant buttons. Exact values in the legends. After sign-off these land as board CSS (or kit token) tweaks and apply to cards and modal alike.
Console: the same kit adapter renders the queue inside a Mantine Modal with the console's existing questionnaire styling. Specced after the board stories.
